chapter_seo_title: Chapter 648: The Abyss, the Five Emperor Tower, and the Eighth Heavenly Stele Revealed
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen escapes into the dark abyss, wielding the Five Emperor Tower against a shadowy remnant. But the peerless female corpse begins to crack. Centuries of cultivation lead to a startling discovery—the Eighth Heavenly Stele is not blank after all.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch.648: Five Emperor Tower, Female Corpse Decay, and the Eighth Stele
og_description: Xiao Chen descends into the abyss with the Five Emperor Tower, battles a shadowy remnant, and learns that even the greatest bodies cannot last. After centuries of cultivation, he witnesses a stone man unlocking the secrets of the Eighth Heavenly Stele.
twitter_title: World of Immortality Ch.648: The Abyss, the Tower, and the Cracking Corpse
twitter_description: Xiao Chen escapes into the abyss, uses the Five Emperor Tower to defeat a shadow, but the female corpse starts decaying. Centuries later, he finds a stone man studying the Eighth Heavenly Stele—revealing hidden inscriptions.
